title: Bill Ray's remote viewing of Buddha

tellings.quote: >> uh they uh Bill Ray I know they had him uh remote view Buddha and that was a uh change life-changing experience for him

plain: Sometime in the 1980s, a man named Bill Ray was given the Buddha as his target in remote viewing, the claimed practice of using the mind alone to describe a distant or hidden person, place or thing, and he found it life-changing. The story comes from Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who talks about the remote viewing unit. He tells Michels it second-hand, as something he knows about Ray, and gives no more detail than that "they had him remote view Buddha" and it changed him. If true, it would mean the unit pointed its viewers at religious figures as well as military targets.
